title: Marées
description: A moving Go on a sinking archipelago. Place and shift stones to capture by enclosure while eighteen tides devour the atoll — and the forecast only ever shows three events ahead. Play hotseat, against an honest AI, or online with a friend in a LOB7 room.
controls: Click a free cell to place a stone from your reserve, or click a stone then a highlighted cell to move it (up to two cells).
Stones with at least four of their existing neighbours held by the opponent are captured.
Badges 3·2·1 mark cells sinking at the 3rd, 2nd or next tide.
Hotseat: pass the device between turns.
credits: A game by Cédric Bernadac, created with AI agents (ZCode & Kimi K3.1 Pro).
